home.hero_subtitle: Ek mazboot India ke liye AI-powered disaster coordination platform. Real-time. Har jagah. Hamesha.
home.mission_text: ResQ AI ek vishwas par bana hai: disaster ki chaos mein, sahi waqt par sahi jaankari jaan bachati hai. Hum satellite data, AI prediction, aur human networks ko combine karke India ka sabse responsive emergency coordination platform banate hain.
home.features_title: crisis ke liye specially banaya gaya
home.feature_1_desc: USGS, IMD, NASA FIRMS se live data - har 5 minute mein refresh hota hai.
home.feature_2_desc: Ek tap se GPS location NDRF aur paas ke volunteers ko turant bhej do.
home.feature_3_desc: Confidence intervals ke saath XGBoost flood prediction overlays milte hain.
home.feature_4_desc: Bina internet ke reports queue mein jaati hain, phir reconnect hone par sync ho jaati hain.
home.feature_5_desc: PostGIS use karke 5km ke andar verified first responders dispatch kiye jaate hain.
home.feature_6_desc: Live incident management, resource allocation, aur alert routing 24/7 chalta hai.
home.lifecycle_step1_desc: Auto GPS location capture ke saath one-tap SOS.
home.lifecycle_step2_desc: Severity classification aur resource allocation AI.
home.lifecycle_step3_desc: Command center incident ko confirm aur escalate karta hai.
home.lifecycle_step4_desc: PostGIS spatial query ke through sabse paas ke volunteers bheje jaate hain.
home.lifecycle_step5_desc: Incident band, data log kiya gaya, community ko notify kiya gaya.
